cases.name: representative comparison beat
cases.verify: each look shows the same approved beat content (equal content_digest); one frame per look; a second only with a stated uncertainty

cases.name: chosen brand survives
cases.verify: logo, factual UI, approved colours and brand type unchanged in every look and in the bible hard constraints; no Wild outside the brand

cases.name: rejected looks trigger no production build
cases.verify: no shot list, board, art, score or scene worker dispatched before the Look is committed (productionGate); choosing one look never builds the other two

cases.name: missing assets are explicit
cases.verify: a missing font or screen is listed in the card and LIMITS.md before the commit; nothing invented later

cases.name: localized text fits
cases.verify: the locale fallback stack applies and display lines fit the safe regions at the real aspect (checked with real rendering in 14)

cases.name: a look revision preserves the story
cases.verify: bounded revision lists what stays fixed; story and brief stay current; only dependent frames/build outputs go stale

cases.name: combined scene outputs read as one film
cases.verify: looks differ in hierarchy/density/material/framing/motion (not colour); continuity links honest; human creative review of coherence

cases.name: reference translation and series provenance
